mapper.select: SELECT id, draft_id, episode_no, title, estimated_duration, core_hook, main_conflict, ending_hook, summary FROM story_script_episode WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY episode_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_script_episode (draft_id, episode_no, title, estimated_duration, core_hook, main_conflict, ending_hook, summary) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{episodeNo}, #{title}, #{estimatedDuration}, #{coreHook}, #{mainConflict}, #{endingHook}, #{summary})
mapper.update: UPDATE story_script_episode SET title = #{title}, estimated_duration = #{estimatedDuration}, core_hook = #{coreHook}, main_conflict = #{mainConflict}, ending_hook = #{endingHook}, summary = #{summary} WHERE id = #{id}
